a musical project by a Belgian couple based in off-grid Portugal, has crafted a distinctive genre inspired by their energy shift and consciousness transformation. Their music is described as mind-opening, hypnotic, and uplifting, providing courage and improving listeners' moods.
Hans, starting his musical journey at a young age, transitioned from the metal scene to an acoustic guitar tuned to 432Hz. Embracing electronic music, he blended diverse genres, creating a unique symphony that transcends boundaries.
Kath, with a rapid shift in musical taste, moved from mainstream hits to Electronic Dance Music, influenced by artists resonating with a powerful energy. Her evolving musical palette includes sounds from Sam Garrett, Mose, Peia, Yaima, and Ajeet, mirroring her inner transformation.
They actively perform live, connecting with audiences through their love and acceptance.
